description: Use this when the person wants an icon for a design, a site, an app or a document, for example "a settings gear", "a red trash icon" or "a filled heart". query is their words for what the icon shows, at most 100 characters. set narrows to lucide, heroicons, material-symbols, phosphor, pierre or tabler. style asks for a look the set has: outline, fill, duotone, bold, thin, light, rounded or sharp. color is a hex color like #E8443F; left out, the SVG takes the text's color. limit is 1 to 20, 6 when left out. Every icon is free under its set's license (MIT, ISC or Apache 2.0): keep the license line with it. Not for emoji or Apple's SF Symbols. Answers icons from six open sets (Lucide, Heroicons, Material Symbols, Phosphor, Pierre and Tabler), best match first, each as a ready SVG with its set, style, license line and the code for the set's own React package.
